verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is documented as a no-code, drag-and-drop, flow-chart-style builder for building, maintaining and updating workflows without developer involvement. The Dashboard lets ops filter accepted documents by issuing country and type, and Smart Capture Link provides a hosted journey with little or no engineering effort. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional branching and risk-based routing logic (only implied by the flow-chart format), explicit confirmation that workflow changes go live without a deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
